planets.name: HAT-P-34 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Sansuna with a 5.45-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-34 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Sansuna. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
